description: The bar chart illustrates the number of factual errors (out of 40 questions) generated by GPT3 using different methods across four datasets. The horizontal axis contains the categories, representing four datasets ordered from left to right: HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC. The vertical axis represents the value, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, and numeric tick labels at intervals of 5. A text box in the upper left corner labels the metric as "Factual Errors." The chart features grouped bars, with each group corresponding to a dataset on the horizontal axis. Within each group, there are three bars representing different methods, as indicated by a legend in the upper right: NoR QA (orange with vertical line hatching), OneR QA (red with dotted hatching), and IRCoT QA (blue with diagonal cross-hatching). Every bar is annotated with its exact numerical value on top. The values consistently decrease from left to right within each group. The tallest bar is NoR QA for 2WikiMQA with a value of 29, and the shortest bar is IRCoT QA for HotpotQA with a value of 5. Other representative values include MuSiQue with 28 for NoR QA, 27 for OneR QA, and 23 for IRCoT QA, and IIRC with 15 for NoR QA, 14 for OneR QA, and 11 for IRCoT QA.
